channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Saturday 24 October 2026
item.description: 4 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council Awards £1.1 Million Contract for Young People's Accommodation
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has awarded a contract worth over £1 million to Stepping Stone Projects for a new supported accommodation service for young people at risk of homelessness.

item.title: £150 off energy bills: Rochdale households urged to watch for important letter
item.description: Warm Home Discount confirmation letters are arriving for eligible households, with the £150 energy credit applied over the winter rather than paid to everyone at once.

item.title: Rochdale projects £10.6 million spending on roads as repair programme targets borough streets
item.description: Council figures project £10.63 million in carriageway maintenance spending for 2026/27, around 26 per cent more than the previous year.

item.title: Roadworks on Elizabethan Way in Milnrow to Begin on 23 October 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has announced that roadworks will commence on Elizabethan Way in Milnrow from 9pm on Friday, 23 October 2026, until 6am on Saturday, 24 October 2026, or until the work is completed, whichever is sooner.

item.title: Your Trust Hosts Family Activities During October Half Term in Rochdale
item.description: Your Trust is offering a variety of family-friendly activities across multiple venues in Rochdale this October half term, including a special Halloween pool party.

item.title: From six modems to 580 staff: Rochdale’s Zen Internet puts people and planet alongside profit
item.description: Rochdale’s Zen Internet grew from £5,000 and six dial-up modems into a national broadband provider. Its B Corp approach puts customers, staff and the environment alongside profit.

item.title: The Healey Dell prophecy: Eleanor Byron, Mother Bagden and what the records actually show
item.description: A short guide to the strange local tale that a Lady Eleanor was “maid, wife and widow in one day” — what early collectors wrote, what the Heritage Centre tells visitors, and what survives as documentary fact.

item.title: Rochdale Wins Gold at Britain in Bloom Awards 2026
item.description: Rochdale town centre has been awarded gold in the 2026 Britain in Bloom awards, showcasing the borough's commitment to horticulture and community efforts.

item.title: Roadworks Scheduled on Kirkstall Avenue in Littleborough on 6 November 2026
item.description: Kirkstall Avenue in Littleborough will be temporarily closed for roadworks starting on 6 November 2026, affecting local traffic and access.

item.title: Rochdale selected for £9.4m children’s mental health pilot
item.description: Breaking: Rochdale will join Stockport and Tameside in Care Together, bringing NHS mental health professionals into children’s social care teams from early 2027.

item.title: Planning Approved for New £11.4 Million Special Needs School in Rochdale
item.description: Rochdale Council has received planning permission to build a new special needs school, set to open in 2028, aimed at supporting children with complex needs.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Friday 23 October 2026
item.description: 1 new story in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Plans for 17-Storey Tower Next to Historic Marble Arch Pub Rejected
item.description: Councillors have rejected a proposal for a 17-storey tower block beside the Grade II-listed Marble Arch pub in Manchester, citing concerns over its impact on the historic site.

item.title: Rochdale Council Generates Nearly £3 Million from Parking Fines Over Three Years
item.description: Rochdale Council has collected £2.88 million from parking fines since 2023, with the highest revenue year being 2025. The funds are reinvested into local road infrastructure.

item.title: Rochdale Woman Loses Over 12 Stone and Reaches Slimming World Semi-Finals
item.description: Vikki Gurney from Rochdale has lost 12 stone 3 pounds and reached the semi-finals of Slimming World’s Woman of the Year competition, meeting Olympic champion Nicola Adams in the process.

item.title: M6 Theatre Receives £73,500 Funding for 50th Anniversary Project
item.description: M6 Theatre in Rochdale has been awarded £73,500 to support its 50th anniversary project, which will include community outreach and an interactive exhibition.

item.title: Two Drivers Have Vehicles Seized for Ignoring Heywood School Crossing Patrol
item.description: Two vehicles were seized by police in Heywood after drivers ignored a school crossing patrol, highlighting ongoing concerns about road safety near schools.

item.title: New HMO Licensing Requirements Introduced by Rochdale Borough Council
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has announced new licensing requirements for Houses in Multiple Occupation (HMOs), aimed at ensuring safety and compliance among landlords.

item.title: East Lancashire Railway steam gala draws more than 2,000 passengers as numbers rise 21.4 per cent
item.description: Four visiting engines, late trains and a tribute to preservation pioneer Richard Greenwood marked a busy autumn gala on the heritage railway serving Heywood.

item.title: Urgent appeal to find woman after suspected human tissue discovered in Rochdale
item.description: Police fear a woman who may have recently given birth needs urgent medical attention after a discovery near Watkins Street and Charter Street, off Kingsway.

item.title: Mother and Baby Found Safe After Police Search in Rochdale
item.description: Greater Manchester Police have confirmed that a mother and her baby have been located safe following a search prompted by the discovery of suspected human tissue in Rochdale.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Women to Host COA in Home Match
item.description: Rochdale AFC Women will return to home action this weekend with a match against COA, inviting local supporters to attend and cheer on the team.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Launches 'Together Against Racism' Initiative
item.description: Rochdale AFC has announced a new initiative aimed at combating racism in football and the community, titled 'Together Against Racism'.

item.title: Are there really fairies in Healey Dell?
item.description: The tale of Lady Eleanor, Mother Bagden and the Fairies’ Chapel at Healey Dell is well attested in local printed collectors — but it survives as folklore, not as a documented medieval event.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Set to Host Accrington Stanley in Upcoming League Match
item.description: Rochdale AFC will face Accrington Stanley at the Crown Oil Arena, with fans eager for a strong performance after recent results.

item.title: Rochdale AFC to Host FA Youth Cup Match at Crown Oil Arena
item.description: Rochdale AFC will host an FA Youth Cup match at the Crown Oil Arena next Thursday, providing a platform for young talent in the local area.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Thursday 22 October 2026
item.description: 6 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Rochdale Council Rejects Takeaway Application on Health Grounds
item.description: Plans for a new takeaway at 159 Yorkshire Street in Rochdale have been rejected by the council due to concerns over public health and the existing number of fast-food outlets in the area.

item.title: Doorman Highlights Normalisation of Racial Abuse After Incident at Ko-Ko Lounge
item.description: Jawad Ali, a doorman at Ko-Ko Lounge in Rochdale, has raised concerns about the increasing normalisation of racial abuse following a recent incident involving a club-goer.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council Introduces HMR Notice to Assess Form
item.description: The new HMR Notice to Assess Form aims to streamline assessments in Rochdale, enhancing service delivery for residents.

item.title: St Cuthbert’s RC High School Closes Following Bomb Threat
item.description: St Cuthbert’s RC High School in Rochdale was closed after a bomb threat, with all students and staff accounted for and safe. The school plans to reopen on Monday.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council Invites Feedback on Proposed Customer Access Strategy
item.description: Residents are encouraged to share their views on the proposed Customer Access & Experience Strategy, which aims to enhance how the public interacts with the Council over the next five years.

item.title: M62 Eastbound Closed Near Rochdale, Motorists Warned of Delays
item.description: Motorists are advised to expect delays on the M62 eastbound near Rochdale due to a closure beyond Junction 21 on Wednesday evening, 21 October 2026.

item.title: Martlet Kitchen in Rochdale Wins Prestigious International Award
item.description: The Martlet Kitchen, located in Rochdale Town Hall, has been awarded the Tripadvisor Travellers’ Choice Award for 2026, recognising its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

item.title: What A Feeling Live
item.description: What A Feeling – Live! the ultimate celebration of iconic 80s movie music! Featuring sensational West End vocalists and a powerhouse live band. Rochdale, Champness Hall, Drake St, Rochdale OL16 1NZ, UK

item.title: Oldham Road, roadworks in Rochdale from 20 October 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Oldham Road in Rochdale; expected timings: Work began at 9.25 on Tuesday, 20 October 2026 and will continue for a maximum of 21 days, or when the work is complete if sooner..

item.title: Police appeal to find missing 22-year-old Sean in Rochdale
item.description: Police are seeking help from the public to locate Sean, a 22-year-old man who went missing in Rochdale's Milkstone area on October 20. Family members describe his disappearance as unusual and urge anyone with information to come forward.

item.title: Road Closures Announced for Rochdale Bonfire and Firework Display on 4 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has announced temporary road closures for the Bonfire and Firework Display on 4 November 2026, affecting several key routes in the area.

item.title: Chris Cheap Appointed Managing Director of Northern Gateway Regeneration in Bury and Rochdale
item.description: Chris Cheap has been appointed managing director of the development corporation overseeing the Northern Gateway regeneration programme, which aims to enhance infrastructure and housing in Bury and Rochdale.

item.title: Rochdale House Prices Rise to £211,000 in August 2026
item.description: The average house price in Rochdale increased by 3.3% over the past year, while private rents saw a significant rise of 8.8%, according to the latest figures from the Office for National Statistics.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Wednesday 21 October 2026
item.description: 7 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Plans to Develop Wasteland Around Rochdale Train Station Confirmed
item.description: Plans to transform the wasteland surrounding Rochdale train station into a usable space have been confirmed, marking a significant step towards improving the area.

item.title: Plans Submitted for Demolition of Seven Blocks on Lower Falinge Estate in Rochdale
item.description: Rochdale Boroughwide Housing has submitted plans to demolish seven blocks on the Lower Falinge Estate to make way for 270 new homes, aiming to improve living conditions in the area.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Manager Provides Update on Injury Situation
item.description: Rochdale AFC manager Ian Watson has addressed the club's injury concerns, stating efforts are underway to clarify the reasons behind the current challenges affecting player availability.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Manager Discusses Challenges After Recent Match
item.description: Rochdale AFC manager Jim Watson reflects on the difficulties faced during a recent match, highlighting key moments and the team's need for improvement as they prepare for their next fixture.

item.title: Rochdale Schools Benefit from Tesco's Free Fruit and Veg Programme
item.description: Schools across Greater Manchester, including those in Rochdale, received over 750,000 portions of fruit and vegetables through Tesco's initiative, promoting healthier eating among pupils.

item.title: Recent Developments in Rochdale Town Centre Highlight Community Engagement
item.description: Recent reports from Manchester Evening News detail ongoing activities and business openings in Rochdale Town Centre, providing residents with important updates about their community.

item.title: Rochdale to Face Fleetwood Town in FA Cup Match on November 7, 2026
item.description: Rochdale will compete against Fleetwood Town in the FA Cup on November 7, 2026, as confirmed by FOX Sports.

item.title: Rochdale wins gold and national Britain in Bloom town centre title
item.description: Rochdale takes gold and the Town and City Centre category title at the national RHS awards, hosted at Rochdale Town Hall.
